title: NO EMOTES, MIDDLE MOUSE PINGS
why: His order of 2026-10-13: there is an emote system tied to middle mouse, get rid of all that. The whole emote system is removed. The strip V opened (HAIL, STAND DOWN, POINT, THANKS, chosen with 1 to 4) is gone with the code behind it, the cooldown, the place the strip took above the belt and the shortcut for it on the belt caption (the [V] signal), V on the keys list, and the speech bubbles over heads: the ones the player emotes made and the two survivor marks that used the same bubble (a nod when a survivor is helped, a think mark when he asks again; the survivor still says what he needs and pays). Hailing a pillager, and the parley it started (standing down, waving back and handing over an item), cannot be done any more. A saved key map from the days V was an action is read without it, so no key is left dead. The middle mouse button is the ping only: in a party it marks the spot or the enemy under the cursor, as N does, on the open map it is your marker, and alone it has nothing to ping. Its press is still claimed in a raid so the browser never autoscrolls.
now: The emote system is gone: V opens nothing, and middle mouse is the ping only.
